# My Man

> My Man is an open-source (Apache-2.0) Mac app, with a Linux companion for agents, that gives people and their AI agents local screenshots, annotation, screen recording, meeting transcripts, dictation, notes, and searchable memory. Everything runs on-device and is saved as plain Markdown in `~/MyManBrain`. Agents such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Grok Bot use it through two local MCP servers (`myman-brain`, read-only search with citations; `myman-app`, 124 permission-controlled app actions) or through the `myman` JSON CLI. All agent permissions start off and only the user can turn them on in Settings → Agents.

Key facts:
- Install: download the Mac app from https://muckstack.com/download/myman, open it once, and install Node.js 22+. Both MCP servers are then at `~/MyManBrain/tools/server.mjs` and `~/MyManBrain/tools/app-server.mjs`.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add myman-brain -- node ~/MyManBrain/tools/server.mjs` and `claude mcp add myman-app -- node ~/MyManBrain/tools/app-server.mjs`.
- CLI: `/Applications/My Man.app/Contents/Resources/myman` (`myman doctor --json`, `myman actions`, `myman screenshot --mode agent --json`). Results are JSON; long work returns a job ID.
- Check permissions before acting with `myman doctor --json` or the `myman_app_capabilities` MCP tool. Agents cannot grant themselves permissions.
- No cloud relay, account, or API key. Requires macOS 14.2+ (screen recording needs macOS 15+).
